user.title: Add CE Smart
user.description: Choose how to connect. Cloud imports every device linked to your Tuya IoT project and includes the vendor's energy statistics. Local controls a single device over your LAN with its local key, fully offline.

local.title: Add a local CE Smart device
local.description: Enter the device's local connection details. The Device ID and Local key come from your own Tuya IoT account (see the README). The device needs a fixed/reserved IP on your LAN.

data_description.protocol_version: Most CE Smart devices use 3.3. Newer firmware may use 3.4 or 3.5. If polling fails, try another version.
data_description.device_type: Choose Light for bulbs. Switch/Plug exposes relays and energy sensors. Generic exposes every datapoint.

cloud.title: Connect your Tuya IoT project
cloud.description: Create a free project at iot.tuya.com, link your CE Smart app account to it, and paste the project's Access ID and Access Secret here. See the README for the full walkthrough.

data_description.region: Pick the data centre your CE Smart account is registered in. North America = Western America (US).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the IP address, local key and protocol version, and that the device is on the same network.
error.cloud_auth: Could not authenticate with Tuya. Check the Access ID/Secret, the data centre, and that an app account is linked to the project.
error.no_devices: Connected, but no devices were found. Make sure your CE Smart app account is linked to the project and has devices.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This device or account is already configured.
